update.title: Added controlled randomization to ComfyUI
update.summary: Built a ComfyUI node set for defining prompt pools, freezing useful selections, rerunning the rest, and saving the final choices with each generated image.
update.previewAlt: Easy Randomize item pools and selection nodes in ComfyUI

blocks.body:
## Keep the useful choices

I built the node set around a short iteration loop: define pools of prompt fragments, queue a generation, freeze the selections that worked, and rerun the rest. Frozen values were stored in the workflow, so refining one part of a prompt did not require copying the whole combination into a new graph.

blocks.caption: Each queue run changed only the selections that were not frozen.

flowchart LR
  Pools[Define item pools] --> Select[Select values]
  Select --> Preview[Generate and preview]
  Preview --> Freeze[Freeze useful choices]
  Freeze --> Select
  Preview --> Record[Record final selections]

blocks.body:
## Keep the workflow explicit

Item Pool and Smart Selector nodes kept the available choices visible in the graph and supported random or sequential selection. String joiners, template fillers, and a freezable combiner assembled those choices into ordinary ComfyUI inputs instead of hiding prompt construction inside one generator.

blocks.caption: Later captures of the maintained interface show the original selection nodes and the ten-input freezable combiner.

blocks.body:
## Save the choices with the image

Selection Recorder collected the chosen values as JSON, and Save Image with Selections embedded that record in the PNG metadata. A successful generation kept both the image and the inputs that produced it, making the result reproducible without relying on memory or a screenshot of the graph.
